originality.rationale: The precise sixth-homology S7 Specht decomposition is not implied by the checked primary statements: Feng proves ranks (29 and 7), and Feng–Wang proves independent degree-nine generators. The new computation obtains all 15 sixth-homology conjugacy-class traces by signed fixed-simplex enumeration and subtracting the already-known ninth character. Related indexed objects (six-point Kneser neighborhood complexes and eight-point triple complexes) are not the same S7 module. A differently named unindexed calculation remains possible.
residual_risks: Equivalent sixth-homology S7 character could appear under an unindexed name or in unsearched literature.

value.rationale: The same natural seven-point complex has previously known rational Betti ranks but its 29-dimensional sixth rational homology carries a non-obvious multiplicity-free three-term S7 representation, including a unique invariant line. The character computation is sensitive to full symmetry, cannot follow from Betti numbers alone, and informs study of equivariant homology and symmetric quotient invariants without purporting to solve the degree-six basis problem.
